scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages docs ops tests *.md *.json
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages docs ops tests *.md *.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
